title: The injective quotient complex computes puncture cohomology
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], W the open complement of its closed point in Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and I any injective resolution of R as an R-module. For every natural number n, H^n(W,O_W), defined as Modules.H of the unit structure module, is additively equivalent to H^n(coker(Gamma_m(I) into I)), where the inclusion is [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-cocomplex-inclusion] and Gamma_m is [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor].

proof.text: The flasque-resolution computation identifies Modules.H on W with the homology carrier of the concrete sections complex C_W(I).

The chain-level quotient comparison identifies coker(Gamma_m(I) -> I) with C_W(I). Apply the homology functor in degree n, convert the resulting ModuleCat isomorphism to an additive equivalence, reverse it, and compose with the preceding equivalence.

theorem nonempty_punctured_h_addEquiv_injective_quotient
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
    (I : InjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat.{u} R)) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (Modules.H (X := W.toScheme)
      (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) n ≃+
      ((cokernel (ModuleCat.idealPowerTorsionCocomplexι
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) I.cocomplex)).homology n).carrier)
